help.faqB1Q: What is Roua Plattform and how does it work?
help.faqB1A: Roua is a smart trading Konto linking and tracking Plattform that connects your accounts across different exchanges (like Binance and Alpaca) via secure API keys to Monitor and analysieren your Portfolio Leistung. The Plattform does not ausführen trades directly but tracks your linked accounts and provides comprehensive AI-powered Analyse using multiple AI models such as Gemini, Groq, and GLM-4. The Plattform offers advanced analytical insights, smart signals, Risiko Analyse, and instant alerts on your Konto activity — all in an easy-to-use Schnittstelle.
help.faqB2Q: How do I create an Konto on Roua?
help.faqB2A: You can create a kostenlos Konto in minutes by visiting the registration page and entering your E-Mail and a stark Passwort. After registration, you'll receive a confirmation E-Mail to aktivieren your Konto. You can also sign up quickly using your Google Konto. After activation, you can Verknüpfung your preferred Börse like Binance or Alpaca via API keys and starten tracking and analyzing your Portfolio immediately.
help.faqB3Q: What Abonnement plans are verfügbar and what are the differences?
help.faqB3A: We offer four Abonnement plans: Kostenlos with limited Zugriff to basic tools and the ability to Verknüpfung one Börse Konto with demo Modus, Pro that allows linking up to 3 Börse accounts with smart signals and advanced Analyse, Premium that adds advanced AI and linking up to 10 accounts with Konto Leistung tracking, and Institutional for professionals with unlimited accounts and full Zugriff to all features. Each Plan differs in the number of linked accounts, täglich signals, verfügbar AI models, and Level of Analyse provided.
help.faqB4Q: Can I use the Plattform without linking an Börse?
help.faqB4A: Yes, absolutely! You can use Roua without linking any Börse through Demo Modus. This Modus lets you try all Analyse and AI tools with virtual Markt Daten, helping you learn the Plattform and explore its features before linking your real Konto. When you're ready, you can easily Verknüpfung your Börse via the Einstellungen page while maintaining the highest Sicherheit standards.
help.faqT1Q: How do I Verknüpfung a neu Börse Konto?
help.faqT1A: To link a new exchange account, go to the settings page and select the 'Verknüpft Kontos' section. Click 'Link New Konto' and choose the exchange you want to link (like Binance or Alpaca). You'll need to create an API key from your exchange account with read and trade permissions only — make sure withdrawal permission is not enabled. Enter the API key and secret in the platform and the connection will be verified automatically. After successful linking, the platform will immediately start tracking your balance and open positions.
help.faqT2Q: How do I verfolgen my linked accounts' Leistung?
help.faqT2A: After linking your accounts, the Plattform provides a comprehensive tracking Dashboard that displays all your linked accounts in one place. You can view Gesamt Guthaben, Gewinn and Verlust, öffnen positions, and Portfolio distribution across all exchanges. Interactive charts are verfügbar to verfolgen your Portfolio Leistung over different time periods (daily, wöchentlich, monatlich). You can also compare the Leistung of your linked accounts across different exchanges and visually analysieren your Vermögenswert distribution.
help.faqT3Q: What API permissions are erforderlich to Verknüpfung my Konto?
help.faqT3A: To Verknüpfung your Konto, we only need Gelesen Berechtigung to Monitor your Guthaben and öffnen positions. Trade/Spot Trading Berechtigung is optional and is only used if you aktivieren the auto-execute signals Funktion on your linked Konto. Most importantly, we never ask for Withdraw Berechtigung — the System automatically rejects any key that includes this Berechtigung. We recommend creating an API key dedicated to Roua only with the minimum possible permissions, and restricting the key to our IP address if the Börse supports it.
help.faqT4Q: How do I get alerts about my Konto activity?
help.faqT4A: The Plattform provides a comprehensive smart Warnung System that you can fully customize. You can Menge up alerts for Preis movements, Guthaben changes, opening or closing positions, and reaching specific Gewinn or Verlust targets. Alerts are verfügbar through multiple channels: in-platform notifications, E-Mail, and browser alerts. You can also aktivieren AI alerts that notify you when unusual Markt patterns or potential trading opportunities are detected on your linked accounts. Warnung management is verfügbar from the Einstellungen page in the 'Notifications' Abschnitt.
help.faqA1A: The KI-Rat is a unique feature that combines analyses from multiple independent AI models such as Gemini, Groq, GLM-4, HuggingFace, Ollama, and Bedrock. Each model analyzes the financial asset independently and provides its recommendation (buy, sell, hold) with confidence level and reasoning. The platform then calculates a consensus recommendation based on each model's confidence weight. This multi-model approach reduces bias from any single model and significantly increases recommendation accuracy compared to relying on a single model.
help.faqA2Q: What are Smart Signale and how do I use them?
help.faqA2A: Smart Signale are trading recommendations based on comprehensive AI analysis that combines technical indicators (RSI, EMA, MACD), market sentiment analysis, and price patterns. Each signal includes trade direction (buy/sell), confidence level, suggested entry point, stop loss, and target. You can enable instant notifications to receive signals immediately, or review them on the signals page. High-confidence signals (above 80%) are marked with a special badge and can be executed directly with one click if you have trading permission.
help.faqA3Q: Can I aktivieren automatic Signal execution?
help.faqA3A: Yes, you can enable automatic signal execution from the AI settings page if you're subscribed to a PRO plan or higher and have enabled trading permission in your API key. This allows you to set specific rules such as minimum confidence level for auto-executing trades, maximum position size, and daily loss limit. Wichtigly, trades are executed through your linked exchange account directly — the platform never holds your funds — we only link your accounts and do not act as a financial intermediary. We strongly recommend monitoring AI recommendations first to understand their style before enabling auto-execution.
help.faqA4A: The Smart Scanner monitors hundreds of trading pairs in real-time and analyzes them using AI algorithms to identify promising opportunities. The Scanner evaluates each Paar based on several factors including: Trend strength, trading Volumen, Momentum indicators, Ausbruch patterns, and sentiment Analyse. It then assigns each Paar a Smart Punktzahl from 0 to 100 and ranks them by importance. You can customize Scanner filters according to your preferences such as minimum Punktzahl, timeframes, and Ziel sectors.
help.faqS1Q: Wie tut Roua schützen my API keys?
help.faqS1A: We take API key security extremely seriously. All keys are encrypted using AES-256-GCM, one of the strongest encryption algorithms globally approved. Keys are stored encrypted in an isolated database and can only be accessed through trusted execution services. We automatically reject any key that has Withdraw permissions to ensure no party can withdraw your funds. Hinzufügungally, all key access operations are audited and logged in monitored security logs.
help.faqS2Q: Can the Plattform withdraw my funds from the Börse?
help.faqS2A: No, never! Roua does not have or Anfrage withdrawal permissions from your Börse Konto. We only use API keys with limited gelesen and Trade permissions, and never akzeptieren keys that include withdrawal or transfer permissions. This means your funds remain safe in your Börse Konto and cannot be withdrawn by anyone else even if your Roua Konto is compromised. We always recommend creating API keys dedicated to Roua only with the minimum possible permissions.
help.faqS3Q: How do I protect my Konto from hacking?
help.faqS3A: We provide multiple layers of protection for your account: First, two-factor authentication (2FA) via authenticator app or SMS that adds an extra security layer at login. Sekunde, a suspicious login detection system that alerts you when access is attempted from a new device or location. Third, you can monitor and manage your active sessions and terminate any suspicious session immediately. Fourth, comprehensive encryption of sensitive data and periodic session identity verification every 15 minutes. We recommend using a unique, strong password and enabling 2FA immediately.
help.faqS4Q: What is the Datenschutz Richtlinie and how is my Daten used?
help.faqS4A: We adhere to the highest Datenschutz and Daten Schutz standards. Your personal Daten is encrypted and not shared with any third Partei without your explicit consent. We use aggregated, non-identifiable trading Daten only to improve our AI models' Leistung, and never Verknüpfung it to your personal Konto. You can Export all your Daten at any time from the Einstellungen page, and you can Anfrage complete deletion of your Daten. We undergo regular Sicherheit reviews and comply with international Daten Schutz regulations to ensure your information's Sicherheit.
help.faqP1Q: How do I upgraden or Änderung my Plan?
help.faqP1A: You can easily upgraden your Plan from the Einstellungen page under the Abonnement Abschnitt. Choose the neu Plan and the Preis difference will be calculated proportionally based on the remaining duration of your current Abonnement. Upgrades take Effekt immediately and you get all neu features Recht away. Downgrades take Effekt at the end of the current Abrechnung cycle to ensure you Vorteil fully from the paid period. We akzeptieren payment via credit and debit cards, bank transfers, and major cryptocurrencies.
help.faqP2Q: Can I abbrechen my Abonnement at any time?
help.faqP2A: Yes, you can abbrechen your Abonnement at any time without any additional fees or penalties. Upon cancellation, your Konto remains aktiv with current Plan features until the end of the paid Abonnement period. After the period ends, your Konto is automatically converted to the kostenlos Plan while retaining all your Daten and Konto tracking Historie. You can reactivate your Abonnement at any time in the future and regain all your vorherige features. We do not charge any hidden fees or auto-renew without your prior consent.
help.faqP3A: We offer a full refund within 14 days of purchase if you're not satisfied with the Dienst. This applies to all Abonnement plans without exception. To Anfrage a refund, contact our Unterstützung Team via E-Mail or live chat with the Grund for your Anfrage. Refund requests are processed within 3-5 business days and amounts are returned via the original payment Methode. We believe your satisfaction is our priority and want you to be completely confident in your investment in Roua.
